product_name: Celfiexpt 71" Automatic Selfie Stick Tripod with 360° Rotating Handle & 1/4" Screw for Camera & Flexible Holder Extra-Long Heavy Aluminium Stable Selfie Stand for Mobile Phone Vlogging Cooking (Black)
description: [Automatic Pop Up Tripod with Magnetic Auto-Close]-- Unlike traditional tripods that require multiple steps and manual leg adjustments, this tripod features a one-tap automatic pop-up system — Simply touch the ground with the bottom button, and the legs spring open instantly. When you're done, built-in magnetic plates help the legs snap closed effortlessly and securely, preventing accidental pinching. Whether you're capturing fast-paced moments, vlogging,live Streaming or setting up spontaneous selfies outdoors, this design ensures a quick, safe, and hassle-free experience every time. [360° Rotating Handle & Adjustable Mobile Holder]--Lift the handle to unlock full 360° rotation for panoramic shooting; lower it to lock securely in place. The phone holder also supports 360° rotation and 180° forward-backward tilt, allowing seamless switching between portrait, landscape, or overhead angles — perfect for dynamic content creation from any perspective. [Detachable & Rechargeable Bluetooth Remote]--Hands-Free Control Includes a built-in wireless remote with Type-C rechargeable battery. It detaches easily and pairs with iOS & Android devices, offering stable control up to 10m (33ft). Perfect for solo creators, group photos, or time-lapse videos. [Universal 1/4" Screw for Multi-function Devices] Equipped with a standard 1/4-inch screw, this tripod goes beyond smartphones. Securely attach your action cameras, Mirrorless camera, or fill lights/ring lights. The 1/4" screws come with an auxiliary mounting knob to help you use them quickly. A truly multifunctional tool for photography and video shooting. [Ultra-Long Reach for Wide-Angle Shots – Stable Build] Extends up to 71 inches (182cm) to capture wide-angle selfies, group photos, or travel landscapes with ease. Built with durable aluminum alloy telescopic rods and an upgraded umbrella structure tripod base for enhanced stability and long-lasting performance — even on uneven ground. [Cold Shoe Interface]-The cold shoe mount allows you to attach accessories such as microphones, LED lights, monitors, or other compatible devices. Noted:This is a large, heavy-duty shooting stick tripod that is ultra-long as well as ultra-stable, and versatile in its features!
